Present (route /api/voice/usersig: POST for the credential, GET for the credential-free availability probe, which answers { available: false } for the candidate); refuses without configuration (JAGAON_VOICE_CLOUD and the voice origins, passcode, limits and TRTC credentials unset); disabled for the candidate. JAGAON_TRUST_VERCEL_CLIENT_IP is optional and off by default (only the exact value on enables it); when on, the failed-passcode throttle buckets by the x-real-ip header only, which is safe only on Vercel (elsewhere a client can forge it, so off means one shared bucket). The TELL_JAGAON screen is present. Live TRTC calls need separate owner authorization

Present (browser speech recognition behind the voice port; route /api/voice/access for the demo passcode); off unless JAGAON_VOICE_CLOUD is on and JAGAON_VOICE_PROVIDERS includes webspeech (unset means trtc only); disabled for the candidate. The browser sends the audio to its own speech service (in Chrome, Google's speech service): a third-party flow disclosed in its own consent (owner-approved wording, 2026-10-11). English only. The developer-only provider selector is shown only when the build sets NEXT_PUBLIC_JAGAON_DEV_SETTINGS=on (off by default). Live device checks need separate owner authorization

GET is the credential-free availability probe: it answers { available } (plus, when available, the enabled provider ids and passcodeRequired only; owner decision 2026-10-12, optional passcodes) (false unless the switch is on and the configuration is valid; false for a cross-site request; 429 with false above its own per-instance window), and reads no passcode or secret, reserves nothing and signs nothing. Any other method is 405 (disabled for the candidate)

providers.recipient: The browser's own speech service (in Chrome, Google's speech service)
providers.note: Privacy inventory (owner decisions 2026-10-11, consistent with consent version B): during a consented Web Speech session, the browser itself sends the microphone audio to its speech service to turn it into text (in Chrome, Google's speech service); this is not local or offline processing. JagaOn's page makes no request to that service (the browser does), receives only the text, and stores nothing until an explicit Save. English (en-SG) only. Off unless JAGAON_VOICE_CLOUD=on and JAGAON_VOICE_PROVIDERS includes webspeech; off for the candidate
